motivation: R19 reviewers requested a concrete producer/consumer account, source-derived multi-residue fallback, recurrent branch counts, and a distinction between compiled definitions and executed positive paths. Do not edit or reroll R19's PDF/reviews.
coverage_wording: Five byte-exact MemTest definitions are included and compiled; the accepted positive paths exercise tick/sendPkt/recvTimingResp/completeRequest. recvRetry is retained but not exercised by accepting-port positive configurations. No instrumentation-based per-function coverage claim is made.
source_inputs: Bind mixed-poll-build/events.json to MIXED_POLL_RESULTS.json source_events_sha256 and periodic-poll-build/events.json to PERIODIC_POLL_RESULTS.json events_sha256. Reuse these existing source traces; this script does not compile or execute source functions.
branch_census_prediction: Among all372 admitted mixed configurations,90 recurrent cycles contain both response-before-poll and wait branches and282 have only the wait branch. Count recurrence from the matched services/receipts, not all transient branches, and report the number of populated service phases.

mixed_multiresidue_example.interpretation: One missing joint residue causes strict slack loss15; both queries certify here. Do not turn this into a decision gain.

slow_poll_fallback_example.interpretation: Completion unknown; exact actual profile certifies. Separate extrema J7 and A5 are tight at different events. Stronger actual-service uniform retention10 also covers gap9, so no superiority over it is claimed.

checks: Every phase at K1..4 for both worked relations compares exact triples and actual service-span profile. Verify the joint iff for these relations. Compare sparse and tick models for all size0/1/2 WU subsets on the two mixed intervals at K2/P25/phi2 and four slow-poll intervals at K2/P9/phi8. Include both endpoints and stop on first miss.
handoff: An offline producer retains its reachable relation proof. At selected P it computes represented completion residues and joint-witness residues. It returns a P/identity/epoch/horizon-bound result; the consumer verifies both sets agree before a completion-only slack query. This is a trusted timing contract, not an independently checkable reachability proof from a Boolean. A period change requests a new producer witness check or profile re-bucketing.
operation_accounting: Build all residue/profile aggregates by one linear scan of N triples. A completion query scans m completion residues plus the two already exported J,A scalars; an exact profile query scans t populated service phases with associated spans. Main P5 has N2/m1/t2; P25 has N2/m2/t2; slow P9 has N4/m4/t1 and needs fallback. If the completion timing contract already crosses a boundary, a producer-attested witness result enables reuse without adding service-phase values. Otherwise the profile may be smaller. These are exact loop-term counts, not measured runtime/storage/transport savings or a deployed integration.
scientific_boundary: Receiver cancellation and timing/residency invariance remain explicit premises. Minimum safe load means all model WU schedules admitting r=s+1 with those premises fixed, not a minimum for a restricted WU language. No new source/native/cache/queue execution, hardware benefit, workload prevalence or external preregistration is claimed. All R19 original scores remain intact.
